item.title: Turpentine Creek Wildlife Refuge welcomes three lions rescued from Honduras
item.description: Three rescued African Lions from Honduras were relocated to the Turpentine Creek Wildlife Refuge in Eureka Springs, Arkansas, in the first-ever relocation effort of its kind in the country.

item.title: Another round of snow tonight ahead of bitter cold
item.description: Light snow showers and flurries are expected to continue overnight and into Saturday morning, followed by a period of cold temperatures and gusty winds before warmer weather returns on Sunday.
